description:
Check that a property can get a Property Tax Appeal Evidence Pack, before ordering. `place`: 'Cook' / 'Chicago',
        'Philadelphia', or an NYC borough ('Manhattan', 'Brooklyn', 'Queens', 'Bronx', 'Staten Island'). `parcel_id`
        optional: the 14-digit Cook PIN, NYC BBL or Philadelphia OPA account (needed for condo units). Status: matched /
        ambiguous (several parcels: ask for the unit's parcel number) / not_found / unavailable (assessor down: retry).
name: check_tax_appeal_property
